decisions.briefing: The market edged up today, with the NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%. That is a mildly positive but neutral session, with no clear risk-on push. Cash is just above the $500 threshold and 3 slots are open, so I'm putting the spare cash into one medium-conviction position, Cal-Maine Foods (CALM). It is a lower-volatility stock that shows every confirmation signal, and its business is less tied to tech. All 7 existing positions stay open, and their stop-loss and profit-target levels will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose modestly today, with tech leading: the NASDAQ gained 0.8% while the broader S&P 500 added 0.3%. No news headlines were included in today's data, so I can't point to a specific cause, and the small size of the move suggests steady buying rather than a reaction to a major event. Leadership was spread across sectors, with retailers (TJX, TGT, BURL), healthcare names (IRTC, RGEN) and crypto-mining stocks (RIOT, CIFR) all showing strong momentum on high trading volume.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日溫和走高，科技股領漲，納斯達克指數升0.8%，標普500指數則微升0.3%。由於今日資料未附新聞標題，無法指出具體催化因素，但升幅有限，反映資金穩步流入，而非對重大消息的反應。強勢股分布於多個板塊，零售股（TJX、TGT、BURL）、醫療保健股（IRTC、RGEN）及加密貨幣礦企（RIOT、CIFR）均在成交放大下呈現強勁動能。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only buying a stock when several separate indicators agree, rather than acting on one signal alone. Today CALM met four of them at once: strong momentum (RSI), a bullish trend shift (MACD crossover), a price above its recent average, and unusually high trading volume. When several signals line up like this, the move is more likely to be real buying by large investors than a random one-day spike.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認，是指只有在多個獨立指標同時發出一致訊號時才買入股票，而非單憑一個訊號便貿然行動。今日CALM同時符合四項條件：動能強勁（RSI）、趨勢轉向看漲（MACD黃金交叉）、股價高於近期平均線，以及成交量異常放大。當多個訊號同時出現，升勢較可能源於大型機構的實際買盤，而非隨機的單日急升。
